solves.reasoning: (A) distinguished fits Hofmann as a renowned chemist. (B) ugly fits the failed black substance. (C) rich fits the vibrant purple color.
(A) abandoned fits 'leaving them impoverished'. (B) persuaded fits 'persuaded his mother to allow'. (C) outstanding fits the excellent training.
(A) wealthy fits 'born to a wealthy family'. (B) disappointed fits dissatisfaction with mentor. (C) financing fits father's money enabling pursuit.
③ dull means dim/muted but original is vibrant. Synthetic dyes made vibrant (not dull) colors accessible.
② enjoyed but original is hated. The young boy hated the printer's work, not enjoyed it.
④ restricting but original is improving. Beltrami dedicated himself to improving (not restricting) healthcare access.
'More ___ and affordable' = accessible. Synthetic dyes made colors more accessible (available to all) and affordable.
'Find an ___ for him at a printer's shop' = apprenticeship. A training position for a young boy at a shop.
'A ___ in the study of animal biology' = pioneer. Kleiber was a pioneer/trailblazer in animal biology.
Conducted = performed/carried out. Postponed=delayed, abandoned=gave up, concluded=ended. Performed is closest.
Persuaded = convinced. Discouraged=deterred, compelled=forced, prohibited=banned. Convinced is the closest synonym.
Dedicated = devoted. Surrendered=gave up, neglected=ignored, contributed=partial. Devoted captures full self-giving.
Wealthy = rich. Destitute = extremely poor, the opposite. Prosperous, affluent, thriving are all synonyms of wealthy.
Frequent = often occurring. Rare = seldom occurring, the opposite. Common, regular, constant are similar to frequent.
(A) called to the bar = entering legal profession (변호사업). (B) metal bar = physical rod/stick (막대).
'A person who carries messages or goods' = courier. Pioneer=trailblazer, mentor=teacher, author=writer.
'Became interested in' — become + adjective. Interest (noun/verb) → interested (past participle as adjective).
'Became disappointed with' — become + adjective. Disappoint (verb) → disappointed (past participle as adjective).
Perkin's discovery helped start 'the synthetic dye industry'. The passage is about synthetic dye creation from mauve.
Beltrami 'leaving behind a legacy of kindness and courage'. His life of compassion, resistance work, and medical service = kindness and courage.
